metadata.case_name: WONG KIN KEE v. NG CHI LAM

injuries.description: Whiplash injury / neck sprain (soft tissue injury in his neck)
source: Mr. Wong suffered a whiplash injury, in that the soft tissue in his neck was injured as a result of the hit from behind.
He was treated and discharged, and granted sick leave from 5 May 2007 to 8 May 2007 in respect of his neck sprain.
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain, stiffness or tenderness only

injuries.description: C5/6 posterior disc prolapse; mild C4/5 posterior disc prolapse with early degeneration of the cervical discs and mild spondylosis in the mid-cervical spine
source: According to the MRI of Mr. Wong's cervical spine which was performed on 2 September 2008, there was C5/6 posterior disc prolapse just impinging but not significantly compressing the spinal cord. There was mild C4/5 posterior disc prolapse, with early degeneration of the cervical discs and mild spondylosis in the mid-cervical spine.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

manifestations.description: pain on rotation of the neck
neck would feel very stiff after sleeping for a long duration of time
had to lean backward when driving, to decrease the stiffness of the neck
had to stop after driving for about an hour, to get out of the car to rest and to mobilize his neck
avoided lifting or carrying heavy objects
occasionally, the pain in his neck radiated to the left shoulder
reduced range of movement in the neck

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency Department attendance at Prince of Wales Hospital (attended 5 May 2007)
Accident and Emergency Department attendance at Caritas Medical Centre (attended 9 May 2007 and 13 May 2007)
Outpatient consultation with orthopaedic surgeon Dr. Wong Sze Hoi at Precious Blood Hospital (between 26 May 2007 to 4 August 2007)
Physiotherapy (at a private clinic in May 2007, and at PBH in mid-2007 for about 25 sessions)
Chinese herbal medicine and tonic foods (claimed)
